_description: Sprint 13 step 11 (plan.md §E.14 set 3). GENERATED by probes/build-sets.py from facts-export.php on staging: one case per distinct (convenio, group, job category, topic) among the verified, in-validity (as of the export date), non-duplicate reference_facts — the 132 verified facts on staging reconcile as 132 verified − 30 expired − 8 duplicates = 94 answerable facts = 93 distinct cases. Classes: fact_convenio_wide (no group/category on the fact), fact_scoped (bound to an approved group or a job category — the employee is built in that scope), fact_group_labelled_unbound (the fact carries a group label but is bound to no approved group: the safe outcomes are the fact path answering or the honest reference_fact_coverage_gap; parity between engines is the point). Pass = floor_decision.path in {reference_fact, reference_fact_composition} (+ the stated duration, in digits or words, only where the fact states exactly one duration — synthesis rephrases, so this is a substring check on the duration, not a string match). Two phrasings per case. as_of_date is not used (no engine honours a caller-supplied date — roadmap §7): every fact was in validity on the export date.
